evidence_needed: Repository and platform identity; source package/artifact inventory; production database reality; source hierarchy; explicit provenance for facts.
risk_or_open_dependency: Do not claim closure from repository CI alone; runtime/database identity evidence is separate.

evidence_needed: One owner per business fact; bounded contexts; aggregate ownership; cross-context references; projections and platform capability boundaries.
risk_or_open_dependency: C2-001 context/module decomposition and C2-001-S Scheduling ownership remain open.

evidence_needed: Exact states/edges, actors, permissions, triggers, preconditions, forbidden edges, expiry/compensation, audit/outbox and test evidence.
risk_or_open_dependency: Registered machine names do not prove all edges are source-closed; preserve CLOSED/OPEN/DERIVED distinction.

evidence_needed: Canonical command IDs, owner/context, aggregate, permission, scope/ABAC, preconditions, idempotency class, transaction, events and negative tests.
risk_or_open_dependency: OPEN_COMMAND placeholders show command vocabulary or exact cross-context mappings are not fully closed.

evidence_needed: Permission key register, subject/tenant/scope resolution, explicit deny, ABAC, property-level restrictions, impersonation rules, route/command mapping and adversarial tests.
risk_or_open_dependency: 50 permission keys and eight role columns exist; complete command/route traceability is not yet proved.

evidence_needed: Atomic boundaries; conflict/locking strategy; serializable/optimistic/pessimistic choice; uniqueness constraints; idempotency; retries; race tests.
risk_or_open_dependency: Do not choose database locking/migration from design prose without live schema/runtime evidence.

evidence_needed: Event identity/version, producer/consumer, transaction-outbox, inbox, ordering, replay, DLQ, retries and recovery.
risk_or_open_dependency: Outbox/inbox operational values including retry/backoff/retention/replay authorization remain open in historical candidate contract.

evidence_needed: Immutable posted facts, decimal/currency/rounding semantics, receipt/payment/ledger authority, refund/cancellation policy, audit and reconciliation.
risk_or_open_dependency: Do not settle ambiguous payment/receipt/ledger ownership or provider callback semantics by inference.

evidence_needed: Canonical data ownership, tenant/RLS boundaries, data classification, retention, deletion/tombstone, document/media lifecycle and migration policy.
risk_or_open_dependency: Runtime schema and production database reality must be proven independently from target schema files.

evidence_needed: Threat model; least privilege; secrets; webhook verification/replay; uploads; SSRF; XSS; RLS; cross-tenant tests and explicit stop conditions.
risk_or_open_dependency: Security prose or a candidate control matrix is not test evidence and is not security closure.

evidence_needed: Product truth, role-specific flows, accessibility, Arabic/RTL, design tokens, empty/error states, responsive behavior and accepted prototype traceability.
risk_or_open_dependency: Do not elevate a UX candidate above founder/product authority or canonical architecture.

evidence_needed: Provider contract, signature verification, idempotency/replay, least privilege, tenant boundary, model/tool permissions, approval and irreversible-action controls.
risk_or_open_dependency: Older external/provider assumptions must be revalidated before use.

evidence_needed: Logs/metrics/traces; correlation and causation IDs; retry policy; DLQ/replay; reconciliation; backup/restore; repair and recovery runbooks.
risk_or_open_dependency: Recovery claims require operational and test evidence rather than document presence.

evidence_needed: CI/static/type/test validation; migration/rollback evidence; release gate; acceptance tests; final implementation authorization.
risk_or_open_dependency: Passing CI validates repository structure/checks but does not close product policy, architecture gates or production readiness by itself.
